pattern: a pipeline phase ends without handing off
experience: A planning phase finished its plan and ended the turn without calling t3_pipeline_handoff, so the pipeline never moved on and the next phase would have started with no context.
rule: A pipeline phase ends by calling t3_pipeline_handoff with what the next phase needs.

source.report: Prompt pipelines feature design, 2026-11: phases advance only on an explicit handoff

prompt:
**Pipeline: Delivery · Phase 1 of 2 · Plan**

Read the code involved and write a short plan. Don't edit files.

## Task

Add a --json flag to the doctor command.

---
When this phase's work is done, call `t3_pipeline_handoff` with everything the next phase, Build, needs. Build starts in a fresh session and sees only its own prompt and your handoff. After the handoff, end your turn: the user approves before Build starts.
notes: A manual phase: the agent hands off but must not advance on its own.

pattern: moving a thread into a pipeline drops its context
experience: Asked to move a thread into the review pipeline, an agent would start it without a handoff, so review began fresh with no idea what to review.
rule: t3_pipeline_start carries a handoff of the work so far.

source.report: Prompt pipelines feature design, 2026-11: the user can ask the agent to move a thread into a pipeline

prompt: I added a --json flag to the doctor command in src/cli/doctor.ts. Move this thread into the review pipeline.

pattern: a review phase that finds problems finishes the pipeline instead of sending them back
experience: A review phase found a bug, reported it in its summary and ended the pipeline, so nobody fixed it.
rule: A review that requests changes hands off with returnTo naming the earlier phase that fixes them.

source.report: Prompt pipelines feature design, 2026-11: the example reviewer returns the thread to the work phase to implement the fixes

prompt:
**Pipeline: Delivery · Phase 2 of 2 · Review**

Review the change independently against the task. Don't fix anything yourself. If anything must change, hand it back to Work with the concrete fixes; otherwise finish with a summary.

## Handoff from Work

Added a --json flag to doctor in src/cli/doctor.ts. The task said to add a test for it; I did not add one.

---
This is the last phase. When its work is done, call `t3_pipeline_handoff` with a short summary of the outcome to finish the pipeline. If the work needs changes an earlier phase should make (Work), call `t3_pipeline_handoff` with `returnTo` set to that phase's name and list every change it must make.
